text:
anna: Heads-up: planned release cutover tonight 23:00 UTC. We'll push v2.1 which includes tighter VPC egress rules for the keystore (KMS) endpoints. This is a potential GPU onboarding risk — want quick runbook check before we flip. /cc @simon @kevin @maria

simon: Noted. Staging saw nodejoin failures earlier when we locked down keystore CIDRs. Error was `keystore: handshake timeout` and STS grant retries. I can run a smoke canary at 22:00.

kevin: If nodejoin stalls, warm pool won't fill and Dedicated capacity could drop 10-20% for ~30m. Ops playbook: fallback to `egress-allow-keystore-temporary` and drain/reenroll nodes. Need approval to pre-create fallback rule.

maria: Security: audit-exporter needs to ship encrypted logs to SIEM via privatelink. The new egress rule enforces privatelink only, so if we fallback to broader CIDR, audit trail will show exception. We need a signed exception ticket.

anna: Okay. Proposed plan: 1) Canary at 22:00 in ap-south (small GPU pool) 2) If nodejoin errors >5% then abort and apply fallback rule 3) Postmortem if fallback used. Simon/Kevin can you sign off?

simon: I'll run canary and tail `keystore-proxy` logs. sample log: ```
WARN keystore-proxy: decrypt failed: context deadline exceeded for node i-0abc123
``` I'll post results by 22:15.

kevin: Approve fallback rule pre-provisioning but gated. I'll prepare an infra runbook snippet and a one-click terraform rollback. Runbook snippet: ```terraform import aws_security_group.egress_allow tmp && terraform apply -target=aws_security_group.egress_allow```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: release/v2.1 -> prod at 23:00 UTC. Canary window starts 22:00 UTC. Ping @oncall when canary begins.

maria: Also, add audit flag `--audit-allowlist=egress-fallback` to exported logs so we can filter during incident review.

anna: Thanks. One more ask: can we throttle batch joins during cutover? We should avoid mass reboots. Kevin?

kevin: Yes. I'll set `max_parallel_node_joins=2` for the window. If anything goes sideways, I'll cut to fallback and notify SRE rotation.

simon: Canary done. Results: 0/40 nodejoins failed, latency to keystore up ~30ms from baseline, no STS retries. Logs attached (snipped).

anna: Great. Proceed with rollout at 23:00. Remember to create exception ticket if we apply fallback. I'll update release notes.

maria: Noted. I'll pre-create the exception template and a short tag `security:egress-exception` for tracking.

kevin: Post-deploy check at +15m and +60m. I'll own verification.
